paragraphs.source_en: The vitality that burst from Matsu’s slender body never failed to leave Toshiie astonished. Even now, she never seemed to tire, washing and scrubbing, sewing and mending. paragraphs.source_en: For a woman such as Matsu to say that she would meet Hideyoshi meant that she was confident; her smile was proof enough. She was confident not only that she could save the Maeda house from ruin, but that she could make it prosper still more.
